item.title: Police Bust Trans-National Human Trafficking Syndicate in Ondo, Rescue 14 Victims
item.description: Ondo Police uncover trafficking rings, arrest suspects and rescue 14 victims lured with fake foreign job offers.

item.title: Segun Alabi: Without Farm Extension Workers, 35 Million Nigerians May Go Hungry
item.description: Segun Alabi warns that neglecting farm extension services could worsen hunger and food insecurity nationwide.

item.title: Presidency Says Nigeria On Track To Achieve $1 Trillion Economy By 2030
item.description: Presidency says economic reforms and inclusion agenda are repositioning Nigeria for sustained growth and continental leadership.

item.title: IShowSpeed: We Weren’t Informed Of His Visit Nor Carried Along, Says Sanwo-Olu’s SA Tourism
item.description: Damilola Ayinde Marshall, SA to Lagos Governor on Tourism, Arts and Culture, says the State wasn't informed of IShowSpeed’s visit.

item.title: Governor Yusuf’s Defection Won’t Affect Emir Sanusi’s Status, Kano Government Insists
item.description: Kano Government dismisses rumours linking Governor Yusuf’s APC defection to plans to remove Emir Muhammadu Sanusi II.

item.title: Tinubu Returns To Abuja After State Visit To Türkiye
item.description: President Tinubu returns to Abuja after high-level talks in Türkiye on security, defence cooperation and expanded economic ties.

item.title: ADC Warns Electoral Bill Delay Threatens Credibility Of 2027 Elections
item.description: ADC accuses APC dominated Senate of deliberate delays, says stalled electoral law amendments risk election integrity and INEC preparedness.

item.title: Tinubu Urges Reactivation Of Regional Standby Force To Tackle West Africa Insecurity
item.description: President Tinubu calls for joint security action, intelligence sharing and use of Nigeria’s counterterrorism infrastructure to address regional threats.

item.title: Certificates Alone Cannot Deliver Economic Prosperity, Minister Tijani Tells Nigerian Graduates
item.description: Communications minister urges graduates to apply skills to solve problems, boost productivity and drive Tinubu’s $1 trillion economy goal.

item.title: Nigerian Army Neutralises Over 150 Terrorists In Kwara Forest Operations
item.description: Troops destroy bandit camps, rescue kidnap victims and degrade terrorist logistics during coordinated forest operations across Kwara State.
